title: JP Invoice Check
description: Two ways to use it. (1) MCP server for AI agents in Standby mode: connect to the Standby URL + /mcp and call jp_invoice_check. (2) A normal run: put invoices in `invoices` and get one result per invoice in the dataset. With no invoices, one built-in sample is checked for free.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.description: A list of invoices (JSON). Each one: issuer {name, registration_number}, date, buyer {name}, price_basis (exclusive|inclusive), items [{description, amount, rate, reduced}], totals [{rate, amount, tax}]. Leave empty to check one built-in sample (not charged). Up to 1,000 per run; each checked invoice is one `invoice-checked` event.

issuer.name: 株式会社サンプル商事

role.title: Role
enumTitles: issue: invoices you send (rule mismatch is an error)
receive: invoices you got (mismatch is a warning)
role.description: issue = invoices you send; receive = invoices from a supplier.
